overview.title: Architectural shell overview
overview.motto: If it cannot be explained, measured, verified, and reverted, it is not executed.
overview.noticeBody: The native engine is not yet implemented in this build. This shell version neither reads operating system state nor performs changes on Windows.
overview.nextStagesNote: Module manifests without live system data arrive in Stage 3 (F1b) and the read-only .NET engine integrates in Stage 4 (F2).

explainable.name: Explainable
explainable.description: Every card in the closed catalog states in clear technical language its exact mechanism, scope, and real trade-offs.

measurable.name: Measurable
measurable.description: Every action records objective before-and-after evidence or explicitly declares why its effect is only structurally verifiable.

verifiable.name: Verifiable
verifiable.description: The engine independently confirms that the expected technical state holds after execution and detects any subsequent drift.

reversible.name: Reversible
reversible.description: No action runs without first capturing the real prior value in persistent storage along with its documented restoration method.

adaptive.name: Adaptive
adaptive.description: Recommendations depend on the machine's real technical profile and the user's declared intent, governed by the Adaptive Core.

history.title: Action and evidence history
history.emptyBody: In Stage 2 (F1a) there is no local database or execution log. SQLite persistence, versioned migrations, and the verifiable evidence chain arrive in Stage 5 (F3).
history.guaranteeNote: Once Stage 5 (F3) is active, this view will display exclusively real records read from SQLite with their prior state, executed change, and verification.

settings.title: Shell settings
settings.languageDescription: Select the active language for the current session. In Stage 2 (F1a) this preference is kept in memory only; SQLite persistence arrives in Stage 5 (F3).
settings.stageValue: Stage 2 (F1a) — Tauri v2 + React shell without engine
settings.storageValue: In-memory for current session (SQLite planned for Stage 5 / F3)
settings.windowsAccessValue: None: this build neither reads nor modifies the operating system

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Structural catalog of modules loaded from the manifest.
modules.proposalPhrase: EVO prepares and proposes; with your authorization, it applies.
modules.unknownDescription: The requested identifier does not exist in the modules manifest.
modules.manifestErrorDescription: Could not validate the modules manifest at startup.
